title: The Smashed Prize Pumpkin
public: Big Bertha was smashed overnight; a window is broken; the greenhouse key has been missing for days.
Mr. Dobbs saw her whole on his 8pm rounds; Ms. Hale found her smashed at 7:30.
Toby and Mia are the club's two pupils; Mr. Thorne is the rival next door, and he is being blamed.

greenhouse.name: The Greenhouse
spots: the water butt by the door

potting_shed.name: The Potting Shed
spots: the watering rota on the door

hale.name: Ms. Hale
hale.personality: Warm, sensible and fair, with a soft spot for her club.

demeanor.open: Relieved someone has come to help, and keen to get to the truth before noon.
demeanor.guarded: Helpful on every fact, but she steps in front of Toby whenever his feelings come up.
demeanor.cleared: Sad and honest. She has said the hard thing and wants Toby treated fairly.

toby.name: Toby
toby.personality: Bright, serious and a little bossy about plants. Normally honest, so lying makes him fidgety and fast-talking.

demeanor.guarded: Jumpy and over-eager to help. He keeps bringing the talk back to Mr. Thorne.
demeanor.shaken: Quieter and slower. He stops offering theories and answers only what he is asked.
demeanor.cornered: Out of stories. He stares at the floor and his voice wobbles.
demeanor.cleared: In tears, and relieved it is out. He wants everyone to know it was an accident.

mia.name: Mia
mia.personality: Bubbly, chatty and quick to giggle, but she goes quiet when she is embarrassed. Loyal to her friends; she sticks up for Toby.

demeanor.guarded: Friendly but a bit nervous. She worries she will be blamed because she watered Bertha last.

dobbs.name: Mr. Dobbs
dobbs.personality: Calm, slow-talking and kind, with a dry sense of humour. He likes everything tidy and written down.

demeanor.open: Friendly and helpful. He offers a cup of tea and answers plainly.

thorne.name: Mr. Thorne
thorne.personality: Gruff, proud and easily offended, but not cruel. Under the grumbling he is a fair-minded gardener.

demeanor.guarded: Prickly and defensive. He has heard he is being blamed and is cross about it.
demeanor.shaken: Red-eared and huffy, but no longer shouting.
demeanor.cleared: Sheepish. Still gruff, but he wants the children's pumpkin done right by.

clue_boot_prints.text: Huge boot prints sink deep into the flower bed outside the broken window, near Mr. Thorne's fence. They are far too big for a child.

clue_glass_outside.text: The broken glass lies outside on the brick path, not inside. The window was knocked out from inside the greenhouse. Nobody climbed in here!

clue_welly_prints.text: Small welly prints with a leaf pattern are squished into the pumpkin mush. Only the club's two pupils, Toby and Mia, have leaf-pattern wellies.

clue_snapped_bench.text: The old bench had a rotten leg, and it has snapped clean through. When the bench fell, its heavy clay pots crashed down onto Bertha.

from.spot: the water butt by the door

clue_key_in_water_butt.text: At the bottom of the murky water butt, your fingers find a key with a green tag: GREENHOUSE. It's the missing key!

from.spot: the watering rota on the door

clue_rota_purple_ink.text: On the watering rota, Toby's name is crossed out for Thursday, Friday and Saturday. 'MIA' is written over it in sparkly purple pen.

clue_spare_key_book.text: Mr. Dobbs's key book says: 'Greenhouse spare. Thursday: Mia, 5:05 to 5:20. Friday: Mia, 5:00 to 5:20. Saturday: Ms. Hale, 7:25.'

clue_ladder_tape.text: A tall ladder leans on Mr. Thorne's side of the fence, right opposite the greenhouse. A tape measure dangles from the top rung.

hale_found_locked.text: I unlocked the door at half past seven. It was still locked! And there was Bertha, smashed.

clue_hale_key_last_seen.text: On Wednesday at half past three, the greenhouse key was on its hook. After that, only Toby and Mia were in the shed until I locked it. Next day, it was gone.

clue_hale_borrowed_pen.text: I changed the rota myself on Wednesday. My pen ran dry, so I borrowed Mia's sparkly purple one.

hale_toby_fine.why: She is fond of Toby and feels guilty for being tough on him.
hale_toby_fine.text: Toby took it well enough. He loves Bertha. He would never hurt her.

react_hale_gloves.text: She twists the gardening gloves in her apron pocket and sighs. "I won't have him made into a villain."

gate.line: They promise to be fair to Toby, say something kind about him, or suggest it was an accident.

clue_hale_toby_upset.text: I took Toby off the last shifts after he forgot to lock up on Monday. I said no going in without a grown-up. He shouted, 'She's MY pumpkin!'

toby_alibi.why: He is scared of getting into trouble.
toby_alibi.text: I was at home all Friday evening finishing my thousand-piece jigsaw. I went to bed at nine.

react_toby_sweeping.text: His cheeks go pink and he sweeps the same patch of floor, over and over.

react_toby_trainers.text: Toby is in trainers on a muddy garden morning, while Mia wears her leaf-pattern club wellies. He tucks his feet out of sight.

toby_blames_thorne.why: A burglar keeps eyes off him.
toby_blames_thorne.text: It was Mr. Thorne! He must have climbed over the fence and smashed the window to get in.

clue_toby_thorne_ladder.text: On Thursday, Mr. Thorne was up his ladder, staring at Bertha with a tape measure. He said, 'Enjoy her while she lasts!'

toby_no_key.text: I haven't seen the greenhouse key since Wednesday.

react_toby_pocket.text: His hand pats his hoodie pocket, as if checking for something that isn't there.

clue_toby_mia_splat.text: Mia said she wished Bertha would just go splat, so she could get back to her dance practice.

toby_drops_burglar.text: Oh. Then nobody climbed in. Maybe... maybe it was a fox.

toby_blames_mia.why: The evidence points at the club, and there are only two of them.
toby_blames_mia.text: Mia has leaf wellies too. And she had the last shifts. It could just as well have been her.

toby_confession.text: I took the key on Wednesday. I only went in to give her extra water! I tripped on the hose, and the old bench fell on her. I broke the window so it would look like a burglar.

mia_alibi.text: I watered Bertha at five with Mr. Dobbs's spare key, locked up, and gave it back. Then I helped Mum at the fair's cake tent from six till ten.

react_mia_pen.text: When she talks about her watering shifts, she goes pink and clicks her sparkly purple pen on and off.

clue_mia_thorne_barbecue.text: Mr. Thorne was at the growers' barbecue, right by our cake tent, all evening. At nine o'clock he bought carrot cake from me.

mia_admits_splat.text: I did say it. I was fed up missing dance practice! I would never, ever hurt Bertha.

dobbs_rounds.text: On my eight o'clock rounds I shone my torch in. Bertha was whole, and the door was locked.

react_dobbs_slippers.text: He rubs the back of his neck and glances at the garden window. "I should have gone out last night, slippers or no slippers."

clue_dobbs_crash_time.text: At about ten to nine last night, I heard a big thud from the garden, then smashing glass. I thought it was that fox at my bins again.

thorne_alibi.text: I was at the fair all evening with Goliath, at the growers' barbecue from seven till eleven.

clue_thorne_mia_cake.text: At nine o'clock I bought carrot cake from young Mia at the fair's cake tent, across town. She was serving there from six till ten.

thorne_never_set_foot.why: He is embarrassed to have spied on a children's pumpkin.
thorne_never_set_foot.text: And I've never set foot in that school garden!

react_thorne_boot.text: His ears turn red and he scuffs one huge boot on the grass.

clue_thorne_measured.text: All right, I climbed over on Friday at four to measure Bertha through the window. Those prints are mine. But she was perfectly whole!

thorne_ladder_thursday.text: Yes, I measured her from my ladder on Thursday. 'Enjoy her while she lasts' meant my Goliath would beat her at the weigh-in!

nobody_broke_in.text: Nobody broke in through the window. Whoever did it came through the locked door with a key.

thorne_cleared.text: Mr. Thorne is cleared: he was across town at the time of the crash.

prints_explained.text: The boot prints and ladder come from Mr. Thorne's measuring, not a break-in.

mia_cleared.text: Mia is cleared: she was serving cake across town at ten to nine.

rota_explained.text: The purple ink was Ms. Hale's doing. Mia never schemed for the shifts.

culprit_toby.text: Toby smashed Bertha by accident and faked the break-in.

motive.text: Bertha was Toby's pumpkin, and he was told to stay away from her.

how.text: The rotten bench collapsed onto Bertha. It was an accident.
